summary: Pop: 90–130 BPM, clear backbeat, I–V–vi–IV, a strong hook, verses and choruses
body: Drums: steady backbeat, claps layered with the snare.
Harmony: four-chord loops (I–V–vi–IV, vi–IV–I–V); minor-key pop uses i–VI–III–VII.
A short, singable melody repeated; verses quieter than choruses.

Apply: pattern/gmd-pop-beat-1 on the drums, then pattern/pop-i-v-vi-iv on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 90–130 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.

drums.about: the drum track (a kit); leave out if there isn't one

keys.about: a chordal part (keys, pad); leave out if there isn't one

key.about: the project's key; leave out to estimate it from the notes
